about: Counts the pages give about trial 2 that no blind reader was asked for. The instance that built this layer read the sixteen proposals and marked which of them do each thing. Every mark carries words from that run's answer, and analyze.mjs refuses to run unless those words are in it. Marked after the answers were in; nothing was predicted about any of these except the first, which is prediction 10 (see prediction-10.json).
